normal.name: Ethan James McCollum
normal.text: In my latest attempt to try to broaden my stepkid's horizons with retro video games, I figured games where we can team up against NPCs is the best bet. We tried out Perfect Dark on N64. After switching controls to 1.2, turning off Y-axis inversion, and adding enemy NPCs, he actually had a fun time!
